name: gesummv
signature: void gesummv(long n, double alpha, double beta, const double *A, const double *B, double *tmp, const double *x, double *y)
layout: A and B are n x n matrices stored row-major: element (i, j) is at index i*n + j. tmp, x and y have n elements. y is output only and its initial contents are undefined. tmp may be used as scratch space; its final contents are not checked. No two arrays overlap. n is at least 1.
